entities.description: Companions, enemies, the boss and its parts, in entity-ID order.

expertise.description:
The expertise gauge (ADR-078); absent in a stage whose enemies and boss give no
expertise points.

heal_pickups.description: Heal pickups on the map, in the order they dropped; empty without healing.

map.description: The map's size, so the frontend can bound its camera (core#87).

patterns.description:
The boss's big patterns announced and not yet started (ADR-103), the call of its elites
first; the frontend draws each as a count-down bar.

progress.description: Experience, level, stat points and the open offer; absent in a stage without levels.

stardust.description:
The Stardust earned so far, times 10 (ADR-109); absent in a stage without a Stardust
factor.

stars.description: Falling stars on the map, in the order they dropped (ADR-079 §2).

AttackView.description:
An attack in progress (ADR-055), for the frontend to draw its telegraph and its swing on the
same tick that `core` judges them.

at.description:
Where its hit box is centred, offset along `facing`, when that is not its attacker: an
on-hit rune's attack, at the point the combo step hit (ADR-099).

facing.description:
The facing locked when the attack started; an orbit's orb's turns every tick, and its hit
box with it.

preset.description: The preset it came from; absent for an inline attack.

slot.description: 0 for an agent's or the boss's attacks and the main character's combo (ADR-069).

tick.description: Ticks done in the phase: 0 on its first tick.

BulletView.description: Bullets carry no ID or asset name: thousands are drawn per tick, batched by `style`.

friendly.description: Fired by the main character or a companion, rather than an enemy.

style.description:
The bullet asset, as an index into the bullet asset IDs the stage uses, in order of
first appearance.

vx.description:
How far the bullet moves each tick, in 1/256 pixel: it moved by this to reach `at`, and
moves by it again on the next tick. The frontend draws it at `at` plus this times the
fraction of the tick that has passed.

hidden.description:
A random rune (ADR-099): which rune it gives is drawn only when it is taken, so the
frontend shows it face down.

named.description: A named star: the frontend shows `star` as its name.

reward.description: Its ID in the run's rewards file.

star.description: The named star's display name; with `named` only.

ChargeView.description:
A charge in progress (ADR-070). `core` judges the perfect window on this tick, so what the
frontend shows is what a release on the next tick gets.

held.description: Ticks held since the step began to charge, 0 on its first tick.

level.description:
The level reached: 0 before level 1, when letting go is a plain step and the frontend
keeps its clock at full speed (ADR-071).

perfect.description: Inside the level's perfect window: letting go on the next tick is a perfect release.

ComboView.description:
Where the main character is in its combos (ADR-070): what the frontend's combo trail draws,
with the next possible presses read from the weapon's tree.

auto.description: The auto combo: the presses auto mode plays from the root (ADR-073).

buffered.description: The press waiting for the next step.

dash.description: The presses began in the dash branch (a dash-strike).

presses.description: The presses from the root to the current step; empty at the root.

window_left.description: Ticks left in which a press continues the combo, once a step has run out.

ContentId.description:
A content ID from the registry (ADR-026): asset, palette, part, preset, status or pattern.
Lowercase `snake_case`, at most 32 characters; the validator checks the format and that the
ID exists.

Countdown.description: A count-down in the snapshot (ADR-103): the ticks left and the ticks it started with.

DamageOverTimeView.description: A damage-over-time status on an entity (ADR-099): bleed, poison or burn.

next_tick_in.description: Ticks until it next deals its damage, at least 1.

ticks_left.description: Ticks until it runs out, unless it is applied again.

DamageType.description:
The damage types, a closed list (ADR-100): three attack types, which are physical, and the
elements. A list for the prototype; changing it is a schema change in version 0.

EntityId.description: An entity in a run, numbered in spawn order. Agents are evaluated in this order (ADR-036).

attack.description: The attack it is making, if any.

aura_radius.description:
A pack leader's aura (ADR-090): the radius, around `at`, within which the non-elite
enemies deal more damage for as long as this entity is there to be drawn.

damage_over_time.description: Its damage-over-time statuses (ADR-099), one of a kind at most.

disguised.description:
A mimic that is still disguised (ADR-090): `asset` is its disguise and `elite` is false,
so the app draws an object and the minimap shows nothing. Absent when false.

elite.description: An elite enemy (ADR-068), which the minimap shows wherever it is.

fight.description:
A shrine's running fight (ADR-090, ADR-103): the ticks left before it leaves unkilled.
Absent for every other entity, and for a shrine nobody has touched.

radius.description: The hurt circle that hits use.

statuses.description: Its statuses and auras, sorted by ID (ADR-103 decision 3).

charges.description:
The charges held, ready or recovering: from the stage's `charges`, raised by rewards up
to its `max_charges`.

dash_left.description: Ticks of the dash still to move: 0 when not dashing.

ready.description:
The charges ready: a press on the next tick dashes when it is more than 0, even during a
dash.

recovering.description:
Ticks left on each spent charge, in the order they were spent; each counts from the
press that spent it.

ExpertiseCandidateView.description: An option an expertise offer holds.

option.description:
Its ID in the weapon's expertise content: a common option, a style, or a choice of the
chosen style's path.

oneOf.description: Options drawn from the weapon's common pool, with a reroll of each.
The weapon's three styles, at the level table's style level: fixed, no reroll.
The fixed upgrades of the chosen style, at the table's upgrade levels: no reroll.
The fixed capstones of the chosen style, at the table's capstone level: no reroll.

ExpertiseOfferView.description:
An expertise offer (ADR-078 §4 to §6; ADR-079 §3). A common one is drawn from one weapon's
common pool, with a reroll of each candidate; a style, upgrade or capstone one shows its
fixed choices, with no reroll. None has a skip or a banish.

level.description: The expertise level that opened it.

options.description:
What `Engine::choose` takes, by index: the candidates, then, in a common offer, a reroll
of each while rerolls are left and another option could come.

rerolls_left.description: Rerolls left in the run, shared with the stars' offers.

ExpertiseView.description:
The one expertise gauge of both weapons (ADR-078 §1 to §3): its level, from 0, its points
toward the next, the common options taken, the styles chosen and the Main style's path
taken (ADR-078 §5), and the open expertise offer (ADR-079 §3).

offer.description:
The open expertise offer: while it is open the world is stopped, and `Engine::choose`
takes one of its options.

path.description:
The choices taken from the style's path, in level order: its two upgrades, then its
capstone.

points.description: Points gained toward the next level.

style.description: The weapon's style, chosen at the level table's style level and held for the run.

taken.description:
Times each option of the weapon's common pool was taken, in the pool's order; empty for
a weapon with no expertise content.

Facing.description: A direction as a unit vector times `trig::SCALE`; `y` grows down the screen.

Fx.description: A length in 1/256 pixel units. In files it is the plain integer.

HealPickupView.description: A heal pickup on the map (see `DomainEvent::HealDropped`).

HitBox.description:
A hit box, in the attacker's own frame: `offset` is forward along the attacker's facing
and to its right.

oneOf.description: A circle sector centred on the facing, `half_angle` to each side.

HoldView.description:
A hold in progress (ADR-084 point 6): the ticks held so far, 0 on the tick it began, and the
most it can last. The release comes on the tick the button is let go or the maximum is reached.

MapView.description: The map's width and height, from its top-left corner.

oneOf.description: A falling star the main character took; it can be skipped.
A boss kill: at the highest rarity of the player's tier, with no skip.

OfferOption.description: One option of an open offer; `candidate` is a place in its candidates, from 0.

oneOf.description: Takes the candidate's reward and closes the offer.
Draws that candidate again, spending a reroll; the offer stays open.
Closes the offer, taking nothing.

Takes the candidate's reward out of the run's pool for good, spending a banish, and
draws its place again; the offer stays open, or closes when nothing is left to offer.

OfferView.description: An offer from a falling star (ADR-079 §3).

options.description:
What `Engine::choose` takes, by index: the candidates, then a reroll of each while
rerolls are left and another reward could come, then the skip (not in a boss offer),
then a banish of each while banishes are left.

rarity.description:
The star's rarity, or for a boss offer the highest of the player's tier. A candidate is
of a lower one when the pool has too few left of it.

rerolls_left.description: Rerolls and banishes left in the run.

OrbitView.description:
An orbit held (ADR-069). Its orbs' attacks are in the main character's `attacks`, in slots
`2 + 8 × its place in orbits` and on.

cooldown_left.description:
Ticks until the next round may start, counted from the last one's start; 0 while a
round that outlasts it goes on.

orbs.description: Its orbs: those of the next round.

reward.description: The reward that gave it, for its name.

PatternView.description:
A big pattern announced in the snapshot (ADR-103): its content ID, the ticks the count-down
started with and the ticks left until it starts.

oneOf.description: The telegraph: its hit box is the warned area, and it deals no damage.
Its hit box deals damage.

attacks.description:
Its attacks in progress, by slot: 0 the combo, 1 the stage skill, then 8 for each orbit,
one for each orb, in the order the orbits came (ADR-069), then from 34 one for each
on-hit rune, by its place in `Rune::ALL` (ADR-099).

auto_charge.description:
The level auto mode is charging the current step to, while it is (ADR-114): its own
field, so `charge` stays the player's and the frontend slows only for that (ADR-071
point 3), never for auto mode.

charge.description: The current step charging, if it is (ADR-070).

combo.description: Where it is in its Main weapon's combos (ADR-070).

crit_chance_pct.description:
What the combat rewards taken add up to (core#NS2b): the chance of a crit in percent
(at most 75), a crit's bonus damage beyond twice (at most 300), an echo's percent of a
hit (at most 100), and a kill burst's percent of max hit points, radius in pixels and
chain depth; each 0 while none is held.

hold.description: The current step held, if it is (ADR-084 point 6).

invulnerable.description: Ticks of invulnerability left, after a hit or from an evade; the frontend can flash it.

kill_heal.description:
Hit points (the stage's scale) the heal-per-kills rewards taken heal together every
`kill_heal_every` kills; both 0 while none is held.

orbits.description: The orbits rewards gave, in the order they came (ADR-069).

pickup_radius_pct.description:
What the pickup radius rewards taken add up to, in percent, before the clamp at
`MAX_PICKUP_RADIUS_TOTAL_PCT`: the pickup circle of stars and heal pickups is that
much wider.

pull.description: The stage skill's pull while it pulls.

range_pct.description:
What the range rewards taken add up to, in percent, before the clamp at
`MAX_RANGE_PCT` (ADR-099). The wider hit boxes are already in `attacks`.

rune_haste_pct.description:
What the Rune Haste rewards taken add up to, in percent, before the clamp at
`MAX_RUNE_HASTE_PCT` (ADR-099). The shorter cooldowns and intervals are already in the
runes' cooldowns and the statuses' timers.

runes.description: The runes its Main weapon holds, in the order drawn (ADR-099).

shield.description: The stage skill's shield while it holds.

skill.description: The stage skill in its slot, if a reward has filled it (ADR-075).

skill_cooldown_pct.description:
What the skill cooldown rewards taken add up to, in percent, before the clamp at
`MAX_SKILL_COOLDOWN_TOTAL_PCT`: the stage skill's cooldown is already that much shorter.

statuses.description: Its statuses, sorted by ID (ADR-103 decision 3): the timed buffs and debuffs it holds.

target.description:
The enemy aim assist and auto mode would face, while either is on (ADR-072), so the
frontend can mark it.

type_bonuses.description:
What the type bonus rewards taken add up to, for each damage type that has any, in the
order of `DamageType::ALL`, before the clamp at the match-up file's `max_type_bonus_pct`
(ADR-100).

Point.description: A point on the playfield, from its top-left corner.

Press.description: Which button's press took a combo step (ADR-070): A or B.

ProgressView.description: Where the run stands in experience, levels and stat points (ADR-079 §2, §4).

offer.description:
The open offer: while it is open the world is stopped, and `Engine::choose` takes one
of its options (ADR-079 §3).

spent.description: Points spent on each run stat, in the run stats' order (ADR-067).

xp.description: Experience gained toward the next level.

xp_next.description: Experience the next level needs; 0 at the highest level.

ticks_left.description: Ticks it still pulls, this one included.

Rarity.description: A reward's rarity, from the most common up (ADR-079 §2).

Rune.description: A rune, one of the closed list.

oneOf.description: On-hit: an explosion around the point a combo step hits.
On-hit: a strike called down on the point a combo step hits, after a wind-up.
On-hit: thrown from the main character to the point a combo step hits, and back.

On-hit: missiles launched from the main character that steer to aim assist's targets,
each hitting once.

Damage over time: a combo step's hit puts the `bleed` status on the enemy hit, or a stack
more of it.

Damage over time: a combo step's hit puts the `poison` status, Dendro, on the enemy hit,
or a stack more of it.

Damage over time: a combo step's hit puts the `burn` status, Pyro, on the enemy hit, or
a stack more of it.

RuneView.description: A rune the Main weapon holds (ADR-099).

cooldown_left.description: For an on-hit rune, ticks until it may fire again; 0 for a damage-over-time rune.

ticks_left.description: Ticks it still holds, this one included.

SkillView.description: The stage skill held (ADR-075): what the skill button draws.

cooldown_left.description: Ticks until it is ready again, counted from its use.

ready.description: A press on the next tick would use it.

skill.description: Its ID in the stage skills file, for its name.

StarView.description: A falling star waiting on the map to be taken.

StatusView.description:
A status on an entity, or a pack leader's aura (ADR-103 decision 3): what the app shows as
an icon with a count-down, or as a row while it lasts.

id.description:
The status's content ID: `atk_up`, `vulnerable`, `slow`, `bleed`, `poison`, `burn`, or
`aura` for a pack leader's aura, which has no content ID of its own.

remaining.description:
Ticks left. An aura has none: it lasts while its entity is in reach, so both this and
`total` are 0 for it.

total.description: The ticks the status was applied for, or 0 for an aura.

TypeBonusView.description:
The type bonus the main character holds for one damage type (ADR-100): the one-type
bonuses of that type and its group's bonus, added up.
